reason: Free listing I might let you do since you load the flyers and it costs me nothing, but I would not pay. Margins are thin and I cut any monthly fee that does not clearly bring people through the door.
objection: I don't have time to manage another platform, and 500 people on a waitlist is not customers in my bar. Why would I pay 39 a month on top of what I already spend on Instagram?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing in my own bar, over a few of my music nights, that people came because of the app, with a paid plan that costs less than one extra drink-night of takings and no work for me.
